name: Inraku no Miko NTR2
source:
Episode 1 "Dark Recollection"
At the class reunion, Takeru heard from a junior about Haruka's side he wasn't familiar with. Although they didn't have a physical relationship, the acts that took place between them were too indecent...
Episode 2 "Deep Delusion"
The junior is hospitalized due to his illness. Upon receiving the news, Haruka begins to visit frequently. Takeru believes that nothing is wrong about this at first, but then he comes across a photo that changes everything.
Episode 3 "Eroding Love"
The issue with the junior was supposed to be settled, but with a new suspicion arising, Takeru's mind is thrown into turmoil. Eventually, he ends up relying on his sister-in-law Hina...
Episode 4: "Distant Truth"
Takeru's heart is in disarray when he discovers that his father and Haruka could involved with each other. Despite the chaotic emotions, he decides to investigate and find the truth of the matter. As a result, what he uncovered was...!
translation:
第一话“黑暗回忆”
同学会上，武从学弟口中听到了自己不熟悉的遥的一面。两人虽然没有发生肉体关系，但他们之间发生的事情实在太过下流……
第二话“深沉妄想”
学弟因病住院。遥得知消息后开始频繁探望。武起初认为这没什么不对，却偶然发现了一张彻底改变一切的照片。
第三话“侵蚀的爱”
学弟的事情本应已经解决，可新的疑点出现后，武的内心陷入混乱。最终，他不得不依靠嫂子雏。
第四话“遥远的真相”
武发现父亲似乎和遥有染，内心顿时大乱。尽管情绪混沌，他仍决定调查并找出真相。结果，他揭开的事实竟然是……！
